ADR-0017 and smoke --drain classification updated. DR-03 fixed by clarification: opportunistic release stated (after any sweeping request only the last 61 s of clients remain; idle retains, no growth), ADR-0014 and RateLimiterTest (asserts idle retention) aligned; no timer added. No human decision beyond the lead's recorded one.
